tags.name: Emperador
tags.note: Very nice guest house, very close to the center of the town. We paid 50 bolivianos for a double room. It's quiet, roomy, it has clean toilets and shower (shared) with hot water all day. It also has internet. (worldvespa, Sep '15)

tags.name: Pizza Italiana
tags.note: Best pizza we ate in Bolivia (to be accurate, best value for money)! 50 to 65 bolivianos for a family size (8 big pieces) pizza. Homemade, fresh, thin dough! Rich in ingredients. (worldvespa, Sep '15)
